questions.question: What is the output of this conditional-expression program? (maximum of two)
questions.code:
a = 8
b = 5
result = "a is larger" if a > b else "b is larger"
print(result)
questions.explanation: The value before if is selected because a > b is True.

questions.question: What is the output of this conditional-expression program? (minimum boundary)
questions.code:
a = 4
b = 9
result = "a is smaller" if a < b else "b is smaller"
print(result)
questions.explanation: 4 < 9 is True.

questions.question: What is the output of this conditional-expression program? (pass result)
questions.code:
marks = 39
result = "Pass" if marks >= 40 else "Fail"
print(result)
questions.explanation: The condition is False, so the expression after else is selected.

questions.question: What is the output of this conditional-expression program? (even label)
questions.code:
n = 17
result = "Even" if n % 2 == 0 else "Odd"
print(result)
questions.explanation: 17 is not even, so Odd is selected.

questions.question: What is the output of this conditional-expression program? (absolute sign label)
questions.code:
n = -6
result = "Non-negative" if n >= 0 else "Negative"
print(result)
questions.explanation: -6 fails the condition.

questions.question: What is the output of this conditional-expression program? (discount eligibility)
questions.code:
total = 1200
result = "Discount" if total >= 1000 else "No discount"
print(result)
questions.explanation: 1200 meets the discount threshold.

questions.question: What is the output of this conditional-expression program? (login state)
questions.code:
is_logged_in = True
result = "Welcome" if is_logged_in else "Please log in"
print(result)
questions.explanation: The Boolean variable is True.

questions.question: What is the output of this conditional-expression program? (age category)
questions.code:
age = 17
result = "Adult" if age >= 18 else "Minor"
print(result)
questions.explanation: 17 is below 18.

questions.question: What is the output of this conditional-expression program? (range result)
questions.code:
n = 5
result = "In range" if 1 <= n <= 10 else "Out of range"
print(result)
questions.explanation: Python chained comparisons confirm that 5 lies from 1 through 10.

questions.question: What is the output of this conditional-expression program? (logical condition)
questions.code:
x = 7
y = 2
result = "Condition met" if x > 5 and y < 5 else "Condition failed"
print(result)
questions.explanation: Both comparisons are True, so the first expression is selected.
